# Indian Institute of Skills & Languages (IISL Delhi)

> IISL is a skills and language learning institute in Rohini, Delhi.

- Home: https://www.iisldelhi.com/

- Media gallery: https://www.iisldelhi.com/media
- Contact and location: https://www.iisldelhi.com/contact
- Digital services: https://www.iisldelhi.com/tech-service

## Key information

- Address: 647 Gram Sabha, Rohini Sector 23, Delhi
- Subjects include computer education, digital marketing, web development, and language learning.
- For current course and admission information, use the website pages linked above.
